name: SectionProperties
description: Contains properties and methods for manipulating sections in a presentation.
remarks: Use the SectionProperties property of the Presentation object to get a SectionProperties object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified section as a String.

parameters.name: sectionIndex
parameters.description: The index of the section in the SectionProperties collection.

methods.name: Rename
methods.signature: Rename(sectionIndex As Long, sectionName As String)
methods.description: Renames the specified section with the specified name.

parameters.name: sectionIndex
parameters.description: The index of the section to rename.

parameters.name: sectionName
parameters.description: The new name of the section.

methods.name: SlidesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of slides in the specified section.

methods.name: FirstSlide
methods.description: Returns the index of the first slide in the specified section, or returns -1 if the section is empty.

methods.name: AddBeforeSlide
methods.signature: AddBeforeSlide(SlideIndex As Long, sectionName As String) As Long
methods.description: Adds a section immediately before the specified slide index, and returns the index of the new section.

parameters.name: SlideIndex
parameters.description: The index of the slide before which to add the section.

parameters.name: sectionName
parameters.description: The name of the new section.

methods.name: AddSection
methods.signature: AddSection(sectionIndex As Long, [sectionName As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Adds a new section at the specified index position and returns the index of the newly created section.

parameters.name: sectionIndex
parameters.description: The index of the section before which to add the section.

parameters.name: sectionName
parameters.description: The name of the new section.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move(sectionIndex As Long, toPos As Long)
methods.description: Moves the specified section to the specified index position, moving the slides in the section along with the section break.

parameters.name: sectionIndex
parameters.description: The index of the section to move.

parameters.name: toPos
parameters.description: The index position to which to move the section.

methods.name: Delete
methods.signature: Delete(sectionIndex As Long, deleteSlides As Boolean)
methods.description: Deletes the section break that sets off the specified section, and optionally deletes all the slides in the section.

parameters.name: sectionIndex
parameters.description: The index of the section to delete.

parameters.name: deleteSlides
parameters.description: Whether to delete all the slides in the section. True, to delete all the slides within the section; False not to delete them.

methods.name: SectionID
methods.description: Returns a string that represents the unique identifier of the specified section.
